messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Chrome/Firefox/Opera gray out
parts:
MM2, it has to do with connections where websockets cannot be successfully used. Shiny Server uses SockJS which provides a websocket-like interface that is either implemented using actual websockets if possible, and if not, then it falls back to emulating websockets using older technologies such as XmlHttpRequest. 

We tag each SockJS connection with a unique token, this is for security related reasons that are not really worth getting into. If we see a given token more than once, previously we were rejecting the second and subsequent attempts to use the token. But in your cases the token was legitimately getting sent >1 times because the websocket was partially but not fully successful--it succeeded enough to redeem the token but not enough that SockJS considered the connection usable. So the fix I implemented is to allow tokens to be reused.
